annotations.title: Open a sprite in the SpriteForge editor

description: Opens pixel art in SpriteForge's compact pixel editor - pencil, eraser, fill, colour picker, palette, undo and animation frames - as an interactive card where the app shows them, and returns an edit link (the same editor in a browser) and a session_id. No account needed. One source at most: png_base64 (an existing PNG), art (palette + index grid), or neither for a blank width x height canvas. Max 128x128 pixels and 256 colours. The user's edits save to the edit session automatically.

art.description: Pixel art in SpriteForge's format: palette = hex colours, grid = rows of palette indexes (-1 = transparent). Optional frames for an animation, each { grid } on the same palette.

name.description: Sprite name, used as the download filename (letters, digits, _ and -).

palette.description: Starting palette for a blank canvas, as hex colours.

png_base64.description: A PNG file, base64-encoded (a data: URL prefix is fine). Pixels under 50% alpha become transparent.
